how_to_reach: Annavaram is well connected by National Highway (NH-16), major railway lines, and regional bus networks in Andhra Pradesh. Devotees can easily reach by direct RTC buses, trains to Annavaram Railway Station, or flights via Rajahmundry/Visakhapatnam airports, followed by uphill Devasthanam ghat buses, autos, or private cars.

nearest_railway_station.name: Annavaram Railway Station (ANV)
nearest_railway_station.distance: Approximately 3 km from the temple hill base
nearest_railway_station.connectivity: Direct trains connect Annavaram with Visakhapatnam, Rajahmundry, Vijayawada, Hyderabad, Chennai, Howrah, and other major cities. Frequent Devasthanam shuttle buses run uphill for every train. Nearby junctions include Tuni (19 km) and Samalkot Junction (32 km).

nearest_airport.name: Rajahmundry Airport (RJA) / Visakhapatnam International Airport (VTZ)
nearest_airport.distance: Rajahmundry Airport: ~72 km; Visakhapatnam International Airport: ~110 km
nearest_airport.connectivity: Rajahmundry operates regular domestic flights to Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai. Visakhapatnam operates domestic and international flights.

bus_routes: From Vijayawada via Eluru, Hanuman Junction & Rajahmundry
From Hyderabad via Suryapet, Vijayawada & Rajahmundry
From Tirupati via Nellore, Vijayawada & Rajahmundry
road_routes: Located along the National Highway (NH-16 / AH-45) connecting Chennai-Kolkata corridor. Motorists can easily drive to the foothills and ascend Ratnagiri hill via the south-side Ghat Road right up to the hilltop complex.
parking_info: Main hilltop Annavaram Temple car parking area equipped with designated zones for 4-wheelers, 2-wheelers, auto-rickshaws, and wheelchair-accessible parking slots close to the darshan gates. Additional parking available at Hari Hara Sadan.
